notes.title: 1 Week 80 day free period is over
notes.notes:
With the release of The Bellows on PSVR the temporary free period is ending. 
In a few days, the game will go back to its previous $5 cost. 
As previously stated if you have The Bellows downloaded it will remain in your library when the $5 amount is applied.

It’s has been awesome seeing how many people have enjoyed playing The Bellows. It has really inspired us to make more VR content. We are really excited to share the new title we have been working on for the past several months, hopefully in the new few weeks!

Love,
Castle Steps

notes.title: The Bellows free for (maybe?) a limited time!
notes.notes:
So this might be a little confusing, but we've decided to make The Bellows FULL GAME free! Recently we've updated the game completely, the whole experience has been revamped and replaced and now is available inside what used to be the demo page. We're going to see what the reaction is, and might add a small price tag back on after a week or so (anyone who downloads it before adding a price back will keep it for free), but in the meantime we hope you enjoy! 

Love,
Castle Steps
